title: کٲنٛسہِ پُتٕل | Kitty Tiptoes Kashmiri Kids Song Rhymes | BuBu TV - Kashmiri
description:
A sleepy kitten tiptoes to the kitchen and learns that sorry and asking first are the kind way to behave.
Kitty Tiptoes teaches little ones to be quiet, careful, and honest with the grown-ups they love.
Perfect for bedtime and playtime, sung in Kashmiri with a fresh, bouncy tune!

سٲرِے وۆٹُھ، "کۆنٛہُ چھُ اَتھہِ؟"
پُتٕل دۆپی، "مِیاو، مۄچھِ مہِ!"
مۄچھِ مہِ، مۄچھِ مہِ، مۄچھِ مہِ، مۄچھِ مہِ
مِلیو سٲرِے، کۆرْو مۄحَبَت!
